latest.name: v0.5.1
latest.body:
## Version 0.5.1

### Bug Fixes

- **Fix crash in `measureChild` with `@Environment(Observable.self)`**: Composite views using `@Environment(MyModel.self)` inside layout containers (VStack, HStack) no longer crash during measurement. The hydration context is now correctly set up before body evaluation.

### New Features

- **`.onChange(of:)` modifier**: React to value changes with `oldValue`/`newValue`, matching the SwiftUI iOS 17+ API. Supports `initial: true` for first-render fire and chaining multiple `.onChange` on the same view.

### Improvements

- **Consolidated hydration context management**: Extracted the shared save/set/restore pattern into `StateRegistration.withHydration(context:_:)`, preventing future bugs from duplicated setup logic.
